Both entries use `groups` with `patterns: ["*"]`, so every dependency, including transitives, is bumped to the latest published version on a weekly schedule with no aging window. A newly published malicious or compromised Go module version could therefore be proposed (and grouped into a bulk PR) before the ecosystem has time to detect and yank it. No compensating in-repo control exists: no workflow performs auto-merge or additional gating for Dependabot PRs, but also nothing enforces a delay, so the missing-cooldown defect is real exactly as flagged.
